newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-SCIFO RETURNS TO CAPTAIN BELGIUM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCIFO RETURNS TO CAPTAIN BELGIUM.

text.p: Enzo Scifo will lead Belgium in their crucial World Cup qualifier against Turkey on Wednesday after missing the last two games of the campaign because of a toe injury.
Scifo's inclusion is the only change to the team which beat Wales 2-1 in Cardiff last month, Belgium coach Georges Leekens said on Monday.
The Monaco midfielder replaces Dominique Lemoine for the group seven match in Istanbul. Lemoine moved to Spain's Espanol from Belgian club Mouscron earlier this month.
"I think I'm playing at a high level again after my injury," Belgium's captain said.

Filip De Wilde (Sporting Lisbon); Bertrand Crasson (Napoli), Bart De Roover (Lierse), Eric Van Meir (Lierse), Rudy Smidts (Antwerp); Franky Van der Elst (Club Brugge), Lorenzo Staelens (Club Brugge), Enzo Scifo (Monaco)), Nico Van Kerckhoven (Lierse); Luis Oliveira (Fiorentina), Emile Lokonda Mpenza (Mouscron).
